subject: Emotions
title: Exposure Therapy
description: Learn Exposure Therapy in one minute.

hook.text: A woman terrified of spiders held a tarantula on her hand after just four sessions. She was smiling.

buildup.text: Exposure therapy gradually introduces the feared object. First a photo, then a toy spider, then a real one.

discovery.text: The brain doesn't erase the fear memory. It creates a new, competing memory: 'This thing is also safe.'

twist.text: Virtual reality exposure is now used for PTSD. Soldiers relive combat environments in controlled, safe settings.

climax.text: Exposure therapy has a 90% success rate for specific phobias. It's the most effective anxiety treatment known.

punchline.text: You don't conquer fear by avoiding it. You walk toward it.
